title: 基于程序化上下文增强的LLM符号回归方法
summary: 提出一种新型LLM进化搜索框架，通过程序化上下文增强实现代码级数据交互，超越传统标量评估指标，在LLM-SRBench等基准上展现出更优的效率与准确性。
summary_en: A novel LLM-based evolutionary search framework for symbolic regression that incorporates programmatic context augmentation, enabling code-based data interactions beyond scalar metrics, achieving superior efficiency and accuracy on benchmarks like LLM-SRBench.
